library.alt: Illustration of a video card dissolving from a shelf
library.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a square editorial still-life illustration for Skwirl, a saved-reels-to-notes app. Scene: a small freestanding library of rounded translucent lavender cards with tiny embossed play triangles, one card in the foreground dissolving into a few paper-like fragments, leaving an obvious gap. Tangible handmade paper and soft ceramic materials, sophisticated restrained art direction, ink-dark edges, lavender #dcd8ff, peach #ffd8cb, mint #cdf3e1, background pale lilac #f8f7ff. Centered subject with generous clear space around it. Soft directional studio light and tactile grain, subtle shadows. This is a metaphor for a saved link disappearing. NO words, letters, numbers, logos, people, app interface, watermark or typography. Standalone cohesive art to be cropped into a carousel, no borders or multi-panel layout.

note.alt: Illustration of a written note beside a video tile
note.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square editorial still-life illustration for Skwirl saved-reels-to-notes app. One substantial ivory paper note card standing upright on a lavender plinth, its surface completely blank except three small mint tick marks arranged vertically on the left and a small embossed peach bookmark at top. Behind it a translucent lavender glass video tile with a tiny play triangle, physically separate from the paper note. Metaphor: turn fleeting video into a useful durable written note. Tactile handmade paper and soft ceramic, ink-dark edges, restrained polished editorial illustration. Palette pale lilac #f8f7ff background, lavender #dcd8ff, peach #ffd8cb, mint #cdf3e1. Centered, ample negative space, soft directional studio light, subtle grain and shadows. Absolutely NO letters, words, numbers, logos, people, app screenshots, watermarks or multi-panel layout. Surface marks must be simple ticks, never pseudo writing.
